title: Microsoft Purview: Microsoft Graph APIs for archive mailboxes as EWS retires (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: Hold: the briefing still describes the worldwide counterpart as rolling out, but its current roadmap record says Launched. The government item's target and the documented controls check out; the archive workflow also needs its preview qualification and a note that Microsoft's import-response examples disagree.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Graph access to main and auxiliary archive mailboxes.
claims.quote: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph.

claims.claim: The roadmap's goal is one seamless archive view despite data residing across auxiliary mailboxes.
claims.quote: The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes

claims.claim: Auto-expanding archiving creates auxiliary archive mailboxes.
claims.quote: An archive mailbox can include a main archive mailbox and one or more auxiliary archive mailboxes (created through autoexpanding archive).

claims.claim: A folder can appear in the main archive while its contents reside in an auxiliary archive.
claims.quote: In some cases, a folder appears in the main archive mailbox, but its contents actually reside in an auxiliary archive mailbox.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Accessing an expanded archive folder can return HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect.
claims.quote: When you access a folder that physically resides in an auxiliary archive mailbox, the API returns an HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect with a Location header.

claims.claim: The application repeats a redirected request against the URL supplied in the response.
claims.quote: Your app makes a new request to the URL indicated in the response.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Exporting an item in an auxiliary archive can return ErrorArchiveFolderMovedPermanently.
claims.quote: When you export items from a mailbox that has autoexpanded archive folders, some items in the response might include an ErrorArchiveFolderMovedPermanently error instead of data.

claims.claim: Items with the archive export error are retried using the URL in the error message.
claims.quote: Reissue the export request for those items using the URL provided in the error message.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: An import targeting a folder in an auxiliary archive returns HTTP 409 Conflict when its session targets the wrong mailbox.
claims.quote: When you attempt to import an item into a folder that physically resides in an auxiliary (autoexpanded) archive mailbox, you receive an HTTP 409 Conflict response that indicates the correct target mailbox.
claims.fix: After the 409 description, add: 'Microsoft's preview guide at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/work-with-archive-mailboxes instead illustrates this import-session mismatch with HTTP 308 and ErrorArchiveFolderMovedPermanently; the Learn examples disagree on the response code.' Add that guide to sources.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: An import-session mailbox mismatch is resolved by creating a session for the mailbox named in the error and retrying through its import URL.
claims.quote: create a new import session targeting the mailbox ID indicated in the error message ... Use the importUrl property from the new session response to retry the import.

claims.claim: Archive folder requests use folder IDs rather than well-known folder names.
claims.quote: Well-known folder names aren't supported for archive mailboxes. Reference folders in archive mailboxes by folder ID rather than by well-known folder name.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn's archive redirect examples use beta endpoints.
claims.quote: GET https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/exchange/mailboxes/MBX:e0643f21@a7809c93/folders/NJWt2LeVEAAAIBDAAAAA==
claims.fix: Qualify the described archive workflow with: 'Microsoft's archive import/export guide describes this workflow as preview.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/work-with-archive-mailboxes, titled 'Use mailbox import and export APIs with archive mailboxes (preview)'. Keep the roadmap's General Availability phase distinct from that documentation status.
